items.criterion: A cash on delivery order is invoiced in Kill Bill only once delivered, for the exact total
items.evidence: the phone's Kill Bill account holds no invoice before delivery and one after

items.criterion: The server recomputes the total at placement and refuses a stale one
items.evidence: a stale total answers price_changed with the differences

items.criterion: Thresholds read the merchandise subtotal before any code and never stack
items.evidence: a 3,098 bag with STRIDE10 carries both the code and flat-200-2999

items.criterion: Every price shows the selling price, the struck original and the saving together
items.evidence: the rendered card, product page, bag and checkout at a desktop width
